name: Matrix Screens
author: Fussell
description: Matrix digital rain as your desktop background, screensaver and lock screen, in your theme's colors. A bar icon switches each one on or off. Hand-tuned palettes for eight themes, your own colors per theme, and the Caskaydia Cove font bundled. Replaces Omarchy's lock screen while enabled.

barWidget.description: Switch the matrix rain background, screensaver and lock screen on or off
